Q10.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(flg.stat) AS completed_flights
FROM flges
LEFT JOIN flug flg ON flges.flges_nr = flg.flges_nr AND flg.stat = 'completed'
LEFT JOIN flghf flgh ON flg.abfl_fh = flgh.fh_nr
GROUP BY flgesbez
ORDER BY completed_flights DESC, flgesbez;
```

Q11.raw:
```sql
SELECT k.kunnr AS customer_id, k.name1 AS name, ROUND(SUM(s.dekl_wert_usd), 2) AS total_declared_value_usd
FROM knd_stamm k
JOIN sndg s ON k.kunnr = s.kunnr
WHERE s.stat != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY k.kunnr, k.name1
ORDER BY total_declared_value_usd DESC, k.kunnr ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

Q12.raw:
```sql
SELECT iata_cd, COUNT(*) AS completed_arrivals
FROM flug
WHERE stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY iata_cd
HAVING COUNT(*) > 150
ORDER BY completed_arrivals DESC, iata_cd ASC;
```

Q13.raw:
```sql
SELECT f.ort, AVG(julianday(f.ank_ist) - julianday(f.abfl_plan)) * 1440 AS avg_departure_delay_min
FROM flug f
WHERE f.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY f.ort
HAVING COUNT(f.flug_id) >= 40
ORDER BY avg_departure_delay_min DESC, f.ort;
```

Q14.raw: SELECT kunnr, name1 FROM knd_stamm WHERE kunnr NOT IN (SELECT kunnr FROM sndg WHERE stat != 'cancelled') ORDER BY kunnr

Q15.raw:
```sql
SELECT kunnr AS customer_id, SUM(fracht_usd) AS total_invoiced_usd, SUM(COALESCE(betr_usd, 0)) AS total_paid_usd, ROUND(SUM(fracht_usd) - SUM(COALESCE(betr_usd, 0)), 2) AS outstanding_usd
FROM rech_kopf
LEFT JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id
GROUP BY kunnr
HAVING outstanding_usd > 0
ORDER BY outstanding_usd DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Q16.raw:
```sql
SELECT s.serv_lvl AS service_level, COUNT(*) AS connecting_shipments
FROM sndg s
JOIN flug_ladg fl ON s.sndg_nr = fl.sndg_nr
WHERE fl.abschn_stat = 'flown'
GROUP BY s.serv_lvl
ORDER BY s.serv_lvl;
```

Q17.raw:
```sql
SELECT lft.mdl, ROUND(SUM(snd.fracht_gew_kg) * 100 / lft.max_nutzl_kg, 1) AS avg_load_factor_pct
FROM lfz_typ lft
JOIN lfz l ON lft.typ_nr = l.typ_nr
JOIN flug_ladg flg_l ON l.lfz_nr = flg_l.lfz_nr
JOIN sndg snd ON flg_l.sndg_nr = snd.sndg_nr
WHERE flg_l.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND snd.fracht_gew_kg > 0
GROUP BY lft.mdl
ORDER BY avg_load_factor_pct DESC;
```

Q18.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', T1.abfl_plan) AS month, 
  ROUND(SUM(T2.fracht_gew_kg), 1) AS total_kg_flown
FROM 
  flug AS T1
JOIN 
  sndg AS T2 ON T1.flugnr = T2.flugnr
WHERE 
  T1.stat = 'completed' AND T2.stat = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
  month
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

Q19.raw:
```sql
SELECT f1.iata_cd AS origin_iata, f2.iata_cd AS destination_iata, COUNT(f2.flug_id) AS completed_flights
FROM flghf f1
JOIN flug f ON f.abfl_fh = f1(fh_nr)
JOIN flghf f2 ON f.ziel_fh = f2(fh_nr)
WHERE f.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY f1.iata_cd, f2.iata_cd
ORDER BY f1.iata_cd, f2.iata_cd;
```

Q20.raw:
```sql
SELECT sndg_nr AS shipment_id, ROUND((strftime('%s', ank_ist) - strftime('%s', ank_plan)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_late
FROM flug_ladg
JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id
JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr
WHERE sndg.stat = 'delivered'
ORDER BY ank_ist DESC, sndg_nr ASC
LIMIT 10;
```

Q21.raw: SELECT kunnr, name1 FROM knd_stamm WHERE kunnr IN (SELECT kunnr FROM sndg WHERE stat = 'delivered') AND kunnr NOT IN (SELECT kunnr FROM vorf WHERE stat = 'approved' OR stat = 'rejected' OR stat = 'paid') ORDER BY kunnr

Q22.raw: SELECT kunnr AS customer_id, MAX(buch_dat) AS latest_booking_date, MAX(sndg_nr) AS shipment_id FROM sndg GROUP BY kunnr ORDER BY customer_id

Q23.raw:
```sql
SELECT r.belnr AS invoice_id, k.name1 AS customer_name, julianday('2025-12-20') - julianday(r.ausst_dat) AS days_overdue, ROUND(SUM(r.fracht_usd) - SUM(z.betr_usd), 2) AS outstanding_usd
FROM rech_kopf r
JOIN knd_stamm k ON r.kunnr = k.kunnr
LEFT JOIN zahlg z ON r.rech_id = z.rech_id
WHERE r.ausst_dat < '2025-12-20' AND (z.betr_usd IS NULL OR z.betr_usd < r.fracht_usd)
GROUP BY r.belnr, k.name1
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, r.belnr ASC
LIMIT 10;
```

Q24.raw:
```sql
SELECT s.waren_kat AS commodity_category, COUNT(DISTINCT f.fh_nr) AS flown_legs, COUNT(v.vorf_id) AS incidents, ROUND(COUNT(v.vorf_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.fh_nr), 4) AS incident_rate
FROM sndg s
LEFT JOIN flug_ladg fl ON s.sndg_nr = fl.sndg_nr
LEFT JOIN flug f ON fl.flug_id = f.flug_id
LEFT JOIN vorf v ON fl.ladg_id = v.ladg_id
WHERE fl.leg_status = 'flown'
GROUP BY s.waren_kat
ORDER BY incident_rate DESC, commodity_category;
```

Q25.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    a1.iata_cd AS airport_a, 
    a2.iata_cd AS airport_b, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f1.abfl_fh = a1.fh_nr AND f1.ank_ist IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS flights_a_to_b, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f2.abfl_fh = a2.fh_nr AND f2.ank_ist IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS flights_b_to_a
FROM 
    flghf a1
JOIN 
    flghf a2 ON a1.iata_cd < a2.iata_cd
LEFT JOIN 
    flug f1 ON a1.fh_nr = f1.abfl_fh AND a2.fh_nr = f1.ank_fh
LEFT JOIN 
    flug f2 ON a2.fh_nr = f2.abfl_fh AND a1.fh_nr = f2.ank_fh
WHERE 
    f1.stat = 'completed' AND f2.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    airport_a, airport_b
ORDER BY 
    airport_a, airport_b;
```

Q32.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.iata_cd, ROUND(AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l), 4) AS avg_price_usd_per_litre
FROM flug
JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id

```

Q33.raw:
```sql
SELECT zoll_land AS customs_country, ROUND(SUM(zoll_betr_usd), 2) AS total_duty_usd, ROUND(SUM(zoll_betr_usd * zollsatz_pct / 100), 2) AS total_vat_usd, ROUND(SUM(zoll_betr_usd) + SUM(zoll_betr_usd * zollsatz_pct / 100), 2) AS total_taxes_usd
FROM zoll_anm
WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND stat = 'cleared'
GROUP BY zoll_land
ORDER BY total_taxes_usd DESC, customs_country ASC;
```

Q34.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, dienstgrad, COUNT(*) AS active_crew
FROM flges
JOIN bes_mitgl ON flges.flges_nr = bes_mitgl.flges_nr
JOIN flghf ON bes_mitgl.basis_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
```

Q35.raw:
```sql
SELECT l.kennz, ROUND(SUM(w.teile_kost_usd + w.lohn_kost_usd), 2) AS total_maintenance_cost_usd
FROM lfz l
JOIN wartg w ON l.lfz_nr = w.lfz_nr
WHERE w.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY l.kennz
ORDER BY total_maintenance_cost_usd DESC, l.kennz ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

Q36.raw:
```sql
SELECT v.versicherer AS insurer_name, COUNT(v.schad_id) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN v.stat IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN v.ford_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_approved_usd
FROM vers_schad v
GROUP BY v.versicherer
ORDER BY insurer_name;
```

Q37.raw:
```sql
SELECT lgr.lgr_cd AS warehouse_code, flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(sdg_verfolg.ereig_id) AS rcs_scans
FROM sdg_verfolg
JOIN flug ON sdg_verfolg.flug_id = flug.flug_id
JOIN flghf ON flug.urspr_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
JOIN lgr ON sdg_verfolg.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr
WHERE sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'RCS'
GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd, flghf.iata_cd
HAVING rcs_scans > 150
ORDER BY rcs_scans DESC, lgr.lgr_cd ASC;
```

Q38.raw:
```sql
SELECT lftyp.mdl, SUM(betank.verbr_kg) * 100 / SUM(flg.entf_km) AS fuel_kg_per_100km
FROM lfz_typ lftyp
JOIN lfz lfz ON lftyp.typ_nr = lfz.typ_nr
JOIN flug flg ON lfz.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr
JOIN betankg betank ON flg.flug_id = betank.flug_id
WHERE flg.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lftyp.mdl
ORDER BY fuel_kg_per_100km DESC, lftyp.mdl ASC;
```

Q39.raw:
```sql
SELECT f.allianz, b.pers_nr, ROUND(SUM(b.block_min) / 60, 1) AS block_hours
FROM flges f
JOIN bes_mitgl b ON f.flges_nr = b.flges_nr
JOIN bes_eins e ON b.pers_nr = e.pers_nr
WHERE b.dienstgrad = 'captain' AND e.eins_stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY f.allianz, b.pers_nr
ORDER BY f.allianz, b.pers_nr;
```

Q40.raw:
```sql
SELECT lft.mdl, ROUND(SUM(bet.verbr_kg) * 1000 / SUM(snd.fracht_gew_kg / 1000 * flg.entf_km), 1) AS grams_per_tonne_km
FROM lfz_typ lft
JOIN lfz lfz ON lft.typ_nr = lfz.typ_nr
JOIN flug flg ON lfz.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr
JOIN betankg bet ON flg.flug_id = bet.flug_id
JOIN sndg snd ON bet.sndg_nr = snd.sndg_nr
WHERE flg.stat = 'completed' AND snd.fracht_gew_kg > 0
GROUP BY lft.mdl
ORDER BY grams_per_tonne_km ASC, lft.mdl ASC;
```

Q42.raw:
```sql
SELECT zoll_land AS customs_country, COUNT(sndg_nr) AS cleared_imports, AVG((strftime('%s', freigabe) - strftime('%s', eingereicht)) / 3600) AS avg_clearance_hours
FROM zoll_anm
WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND stat = 'cleared'
GROUP BY zoll_land
HAVING cleared_imports >= 50
ORDER BY avg_clearance_hours ASC, customs_country ASC;
```

Q43.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    sndg_nr AS shipment_id, 
    lbf_nr AS awb_number, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND (temperature_c < temp_min_c OR temperature_c > temp_max_c) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_range_readings, 
    MAX(CASE WHEN temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND (temperature_c < temp_min_c OR temperature_c > temp_max_c) THEN 
        LEAST(ABS(temperature_c - temp_min_c), ABS(temperature_c - temp_max_c)) ELSE 0 END) AS max_deviation_c
FROM 
    sdg_verfolg
JOIN 
    sndg ON sdg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr
GROUP BY 
    sndg_nr, lbf_nr
ORDER BY 
    sndg_nr;
```

Q44.raw:
```sql
SELECT v.ursache AS root_cause, COUNT(v.vorf_id) AS incidents, SUM(CASE WHEN vs.stat IN ('approved', 'paid') THEN vs.ford_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_approved_usd
FROM vorf v
LEFT JOIN vers_schad vs ON v.vorf_id = vs.vorf_id
GROUP BY v.ursache
ORDER BY v.ursache;
```

Q45.raw:
```sql
SELECT s.awb_number, s.destination_iata, z.import_status
FROM sndg s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sndg_nr, declaration_type, MAX(ereig_zeit) AS last_event_time
    FROM sdg_verfolg
    WHERE ereig_cd = 'DLV'
    GROUP BY sndg_nr
) d ON s.sndg_nr = d.sndg_nr
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sndg_nr, declaration_type, CASE WHEN ereig_cd = 'DLV' THEN 'Handed over' ELSE NULL END AS import_status
    FROM sdg_verfolg
    WHERE ereig_cd = 'DLV'
) z ON s.sndg_nr = z.sndg_nr
WHERE s.stat = 'delivered' AND (d.last_event_time IS NULL OR d.last_event_time < '2025-12-20')
ORDER BY s.awb_number;
```
